realizes.rationale: The provider derives shown transitions and exposes a local revalidate callback through React context. Both explicit reviewer refresh and the matching live-review memory hook use that callback; the entry generation joins its facts key. The context itself creates no transport. Conditional/read coalescing belongs to the existing summary owner, not an unconditional one-network-read-per-callback rule.

1.note:
The local provider increments generation on a false-to-true shown transition and on revalidate. useReviewMemoryWatch registers only for an active live enclosure and non-recorded history, invokes shared entry revalidation alongside review invalidation/refresh, and filters notifications by exact registered scope. publishReviewMemory reconciles first/initial baselines and changed revisions. connectState carries that scope and dispatches memory events through its existing SSE connection. The original header-only no-signal account is superseded.
